GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 676.3 (28 Jan 46) CCS
(SCAPIN - 666)
28 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Certificate for Authorized Demobilization Ministry Radio Stations.
1. Reference is made to letter from Liaison Commission (Tokyo) for the Imperial Japanese Demobilization Ministries file S643 dated 11 January 1946, subject "Application for Issuance of Certificates of Communication at Signal Offices in Japan".
2. Memorandum this Headquarters, file AG 676.3 (20 Nov 45)CCS dated 20 November 1945, subject "Control of Radio Communications", states that radio stations not disapproved by this Headquarters may remain in service until such time as closure is effected by the Demobilization Ministries or directed by this Headquarters.
3. In view of the above and since occupation troops have been informed of the locations of authorized stations, no certificates of authorization will be issued.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
